about: Professional, licence-checked medical art stored in the repo so cards start from real illustrations instead of hand-drawn shapes. Import with: python3 tools/motioncards.py import-svg lib:<name> --scene <scene.json> --id <id> --box x,y,w,h (the credit is added automatically). Source: Servier Medical Art (smart.servier.com) via the bioicons repository (github.com/duerrsimon/bioicons), CC BY 3.0: attribution is required and modifying the art is allowed.

healthy-lung.view: coronal thorax: both lungs with lobes and fissures, trachea, larynx, rib ends, diaphragm floor
healthy-lung.use: pleura, lungs, diaphragm, phrenic nerve, mediastinum

lung.view: both lungs with trachea and main bronchi, no ribs

pneumothorax.view: thorax like healthy-lung with the left lung collapsed and air shaded blue

lung-cancer.view: smoker's lung with a tumour beside a healthy lung (has small text labels; hide or cover them)

heart.view: anterior heart with great vessels, SVC/IVC in blue, coronary arteries

heart-valves.view: heart opened to show the valves

aorta.view: whole aorta from arch to bifurcation with branches

stomach.view: simple stomach with distal oesophagus and duodenum, no labels

hiatal-hernia.view: sliding hiatus hernia: oesophagus, diaphragm band, stomach above and below

lymphatic-system.view: stomach with lymphatics and green lymph nodes along the curvatures

pancreas.view: pancreas alone, anterior view, head on the left of the image, tail on the right
pancreas.use: pancreas, pseudocyst, head mass, splenic artery course

spleen.use: splenic injury, splenic artery, left upper quadrant

man-standing.view: clothed older man standing, front view

liver-3d.view: liver with right and left lobes and inferior surface shading, anterior view (right lobe on the left of the image)
liver-3d.use: liver trauma, Pringle manoeuvre, porta hepatis

pelvis-front.view: male bony pelvis, anterior view: sacrum, iliac wings, pubic symphysis, obturator foramina
pelvis-front.use: pelvic brim, iliac vessels, ureters, pelvic fractures
pelvis-front.credit: Togo Picture Gallery © DBCLS, CC BY 4.0

pelvis-back.view: male bony pelvis, posterior view: sacrum with sacral foramina, ischial spines and tuberosities
pelvis-back.use: sacral roots, pudendal nerve, sciatic notch
pelvis-back.credit: Togo Picture Gallery © DBCLS, CC BY 4.0

hip-bone-lateral.view: right hip bone, lateral view: acetabulum, obturator foramen
hip-bone-lateral.credit: Togo Picture Gallery © DBCLS, CC BY 4.0

back-muscles.view: whole body from behind with superficial muscles (buttocks visible)
back-muscles.use: dermatomes of the back and buttock, sciatica

bladder.view: bladder opened in coronal section with ureters entering and the start of the urethra

rectum.view: rectum and anal canal opened in coronal section with sphincters and ischioanal fat

kidney-cut.view: single kidney with renal pelvis and upper ureter, darker style

pelvis-front-female.view: female bony pelvis, anterior view (wider, rounder inlet)
pelvis-front-female.credit: Togo Picture Gallery © DBCLS, CC BY 4.0

pelvis-back-female.view: female bony pelvis, posterior view: sacral foramina, ischial spines
pelvis-back-female.use: pudendal nerve, sacral roots in women
pelvis-back-female.credit: Togo Picture Gallery © DBCLS, CC BY 4.0

credit_note: Each item uses 'credit' when present, otherwise the top-level 'credit'. Never mix styles (servier vs togo) in one card.
